data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a modest prior year release. The gross claims development triangle indicates a gross release of approximately GBP 3.5m (driven primarily by movements in the 2018 underwriting year). The accounts also state a net favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m (net of reinsurance), largely reflecting favourable experience and reinsurance-related movements (the 'Reinsurance' line shows a large favourable contribution). Current year reserve movements were affected by named natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricane Sally) and management recognised additional reserves for potential COVID-19 impacts for 2020.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year movement (gross PYD) was not stated explicitly in a single gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line. A gross prior-year figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (one prior underwriting year, 2018) yielding a gross release of ~GBP 3.502m. The accounts explicitly state a net favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m (net of reinsurance) in the P&L note; the movement-by-line table shown in the note is net of reinsurance. Therefore there is a mismatch between the gross triangle-derived figure and the reported net PYD; the gross triangle is limited (only 2018 is an older underwriting year) which reduces robustness. Prior year per-line movements quoted in the notes are net amounts and have been used for LOB-level movements (flagged as net).
